text:
leo (sre): FYI: Planned cross-AZ maintenance next Friday 01:00-02:30 UTC. Goal: replace noisy NICs and rebalance edge-router attachments. Expect transient connection resets for <10s per connection as we shift tunnels. No SLA change but SLO window for tail latency will be temporarily widened.

anya (oncall): will we run any heavy load tests during the window? want to avoid coinciding with weekly regen jobs.

leo (sre): no synthetic load tests during the maintenance. We will run targeted health checks and a small read-only canary to validate topology. regen jobs are deferred by 6 hours.

tai (infra): networking plan summary: 1) drain one router nic at a time 2) failover sessions with pre-warmed routes 3) verify BGP convergence < 15s 4) roll forward. We will disable autoscaling triggers for the duration to avoid noisy scale events.

beth (product): can we notify customers with Dedicated reserved capacity? small note in console and email for tenants with active commits. Ops, please use the existing template.

ops-bot: Notification draft saved: "Scheduled network maintenance (non-customer-impacting) Fri 01:00 UTC". Will send 48h + 1h reminders.

leo (sre): Alerts/thresholds: - temporarily mute alert: node-drain-noisy ~= true - keep alert: error-rate > 0.8% for 3m -> page - keep alert: p99-latency > 120ms for 5m -> page. If both error-rate and p99 hit, increase severity.

anya (oncall): runbook link? want quick rollback steps in case BGP flaps longer than expected.

leo (sre): runbook added to ops vault: https://redwood.internal/ops/network-maint-2026. Key rollback steps: reattach routes, revert nic firmware, enable autoscaling. Manual inc call if BGP > 60s.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: cluster-health=OK, drains-ready=12/12, bgp-peers=stable.

leo (sre): Post-maint tests: 1) synthetic edge-to-model P99 check 2) kv-cache hitrate sanity 3) probe job success across AZs. Aim to complete checks within 30m after finish.

tai (infra): Scheduling note: we'll start with eu-central-1 -> us-west-2 -> us-east-1 order. Each AZ window ~20m.

beth (product): Thanks. I'll approve the customer message. Please tag me when it's queued.

anya (oncall): I'll be on-call through the window. pager rotation adjusted and escalation contact is leo.

leo (sre): Appreciate it. Final checklist: ops-bot attach incident channel (eng-sre/incident-ops) and set calendar entry. If P99 > 150ms for >5m, open incident and escalate to oncall@redwood.ai.

ops-bot: Calendar event: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/net-maint-1930007777. Incident channel created: #incident-network-1930007777.

leo (sre): Thanks team. Small reminder: avoid major deploys 2h before and after maintenance. Marking release freeze in release-war-room.

anya (oncall): acknowledged.

leo (sre): closing thread; updates will be posted in incident channel if anything changes.
